description: Fetches and returns publicly available YouTube caption tracks; it does not transcribe audio. Accepts allowed YouTube URLs or raw video IDs, exact ISO 639-1/BCP-47 language codes such as pt-BR, es-419, and zh-Hans, and formats items into timestamped lines. If the requested track is unavailable, returns an error rather than another language.

lang.description: Optional ISO 639-1/BCP-47 language code, including regional or script subtags such as "pt-BR" or "zh-Hans"

videoIdOrUrl.description: The YouTube video URL (e.g. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ or https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ) or raw 11-character video ID

name: get_youtube_transcript
title: Get YouTube Transcript
